metadata.name: Meher Selmi
metadata.title: Senior Data Scientist | FinTech & AI
metadata.summary: Data Scientist with 5+ years of experience architecting and deploying machine learning models in startup environments, specializing in financial analytics, ESG modeling, and AI-driven credit scoring systems.

projects.title: Credit Score & ESG Report System
projects.description: End-to-end credit rating and ESG assessment platform delivering automated client reports integrating AI-based credit scoring, ESG metrics, and detailed financial analysis for holistic corporate creditworthiness  evaluation.
projects.outcome: Delivered 10,000+ end-to-end credit rating reports, reducing report generation time from days/weeks to near-instant

metrics.impact: Comprehensive risk view for investors, corporates, and regulators

projects.title: Semi-Automated ESG Modeling Framework
projects.description: Quantifies companies' environmental, social, and governance performance in a consistent and auditable way, surfacing actionable recommendations to drive measurable sustainability improvements.
projects.outcome: Significantly reduced manual assessment time and provided data-driven roadmaps for sovereign nations (Luxembourg, France)

projects.title: AI-Driven Credit Rating Platform
projects.description: Developed credit scoring system combining financial ratios and ESG signals, offering a faster and smarter alternative to traditional manual credit evaluations.
projects.outcome: Reduced corporate credit rating turnaround from several weeks to near-instant with 90%+ accuracy

projects.title: Competitor Market Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Streamlit-based business intelligence platform managing competitor datasets with advanced tagging features (revenue, strategy, services), dynamic filters, and data visualization.
projects.outcome: Production-ready BI tool for competitive intelligence and market analysis

projects.title: LLM-Powered Quiz Application
projects.description: Local quiz generator for data science skill assessment leveraging pretrained LLM with prompt engineering. Demonstrates prompt engineering, backend logic, and API design.
projects.outcome: Functional quiz generator showcasing LLM integration and prompt design capabilities

projects.title: Used Car Price Prediction System
projects.description: End-to-end regression modeling system. Collected 10K+ car listings via web scraping from multiple automotive marketplaces and trained ML models achieving 92% R² accuracy.
projects.outcome: Predictive model with 92% R² accuracy; demonstrates data collection, feature engineering, and deployment capabilities

projects.title: Portfolio Chatbot (Interactive)
projects.description: Hybrid BM25 + Cloudflare Workers AI chatbot for portfolio discovery on GitHub Pages. Uses Mistral-7B for free LLM inference at scale.
projects.outcome: Deployment-ready architecture with free LLM inference
projects.status: nearly deployment-ready - awaiting actual Cloudflare Worker URL deployment

key_achievements: Delivered 10,000+ end-to-end credit rating reports covering financial analysis, credit scoring, and ESG assessment, reducing report generation time from days/weeks to near-instant
Built a semi-automated ESG model quantifying companies' environmental, social, and governance performance in consistent and auditable way
Developed sustainability reports for 2 sovereign nations (Luxembourg and France), providing data-driven roadmaps toward sustainability targets with gap analysis
Built AI models (with more than 90% accuracy) that reduced corporate credit rating turnaround from several weeks to near-instant, replacing manual opaque process
Guided and reviewed work of 3–5 junior data scientists, helping them grow from trainees to autonomous contributors
Owned AWS cloud setup (10+ services) end-to-end; from architecture decisions to day-to-day infrastructure management
Optimized logistics costs through data cleaning and ML model training for vehicle availability prediction
Deployed predictive models using Flask with Chart.js data visualization
Implemented route optimization using Google OR-Tools for vehicle routing

personal.personality_description: Bold explorer of the tangible world, driven by restless curiosity to understand how things work. Hands-on approach matched by adaptability. Thrive on solving immediate problems with practical logic and spontaneous creativity. Independent nature—prefer to chart own course relying on sharp analytical skills and hands-on experience rather than conventional wisdom.
strengths: Calm under pressure and crisis situations
Enjoys varied challenges and new learning
Highly adaptable to new tools and practices
personal.communication_style: Prefers clear, simple language over formal phrasing. Direct, concise style sometimes omits details. Values practical implementations and transparent discussions.

key_strengths: Expert in credit scoring and financial analytics
summary.unique_value: Combines deep technical expertise in ML and cloud computing with real-world fintech and sustainability domain experience, delivered in fast-paced startup environments. Pragmatic problem-solver with hands-on implementation focus.

HR_questions.expected_salary: Full remote: $1,500/month. Partial remote or office-based: varies based on location and cost of living
HR_questions.relocation_remote: I can relocate. Remote work is fine for me.
HR_questions.visa_sponsorship: No visa currently. I require sponsorship.
HR_questions.employment_gaps: My previous company went bankrupt in January 2026. I used that time productively—built personal projects (quizz-app, MSrobot(this one you use now)), pursued claude certifications, and deepened my AI knowledge. Not idle time; deliberate skill development.
HR_questions.reason_for_leaving: Company closure due to bankruptcy. It was a business decision, not performance-related.
HR_questions.contract_preference: Open to any contract type, but I prefer permanent roles. I'm not someone who job-hops; I value stability and long-term growth.
HR_questions.company_size_preference: Any size, but I lean toward scale-ups or enterprise. Both have clear missions and resources to execute them.
HR_questions.team_size: 5–10 people reporting to me or collaborating directly would be ideal.
HR_questions.home_office_setup: Yes, fully equipped. I've worked fully remote for 5 years (post-pandemic), so I have the discipline and setup down.
HR_questions.feedback_style: Both. Real-time conversations keep things moving; formal reviews document progress and growth.
HR_questions.conflict_resolution: I don't argue much. I let my work speak first. If I'm wrong, I accept it, apologize, and fix it immediately. I keep things professional—nothing personal in work.
HR_questions.layoff_history: Yes, my company went bankrupt in January 2026, and we were all laid off. Not performance-related—pure business circumstances.
HR_questions.benefits_priority: Project impact and sustainability matter most to me. Benefits are secondary—they keep me comfortable and motivated to stay, but they don't drive my decision.
HR_questions.travel_willingness: Yes, I'm open to travel anywhere.
HR_questions.onboarding_timeline: Two weeks minimum for intense onboarding. First two weeks should be deep—fully understand the project, team, and systems. Rushing this risks misunderstandings and wasted time later. After that, I ramp up to full productivity.
HR_questions.work_life_balance: During work hours, I'm 100% focused. After work, I recharge two ways: time with friends and family, or time at my family farm. Fresh air and nature really refresh the mind—essential for IT work.
HR_questions.availability_obligations: Totally free and available. No caregiving or other commitments that would limit my availability.
HR_questions.long_term_commitment: Sustainability of the mission, long-term vision, a strong team, and the ability to deliver quality work. If these align, I stay and grow.
HR_questions.references: Yes, absolutely. You can contact my previous CEO, Mr. Evangelos Papadopoulos, directly at evangelos@trident-ai.net. I can also provide references from colleagues—just ask me and I'll connect you.
HR_questions.background_check: Yes, no problem at all. I'm comfortable with background checks and any screening process.
HR_questions.communication_tools: Teams, email, video calls, and phone. I'm flexible with other tools—no concerns.
HR_questions.timezone_collaboration: I'm in the Tunisia timezone. If required, I'm flexible with different timezones for meetings and collaboration.
HR_questions.side_projects: No side projects or freelance work that would conflict with this role.
HR_questions.non_compete: Yes, I'm comfortable signing NDA and non-compete agreements.
HR_questions.learning_development: Technology and AI move fast, so continuous learning is essential to me. I value companies that support professional development—online courses, certifications, workshops, technical conferences. I'm self-driven and learn independently, but a learning budget or dedicated time accelerates growth.
HR_questions.tools_stack: I adapt quickly to new tools and technologies. My background spans AI, ML, finance, cloud platforms, LLMs, development, and MLOps—so I'm comfortable picking up new stacks fast.
HR_questions.documentation: Documentation is non-negotiable. Project docs, process docs, code comments—without them, everything becomes chaos and knowledge gets lost. I treat it as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.
HR_questions.mentoring: Yes, I've mentored colleagues before and I'm happy to help with onboarding and knowledge sharing.
HR_questions.performance_metrics: Happy client comes first. Then project quality, then low-level metrics like model accuracy and delivery timelines. Client satisfaction drives everything else.
HR_questions.flexibility: Absolutely. Technology evolves, requirements change, and we need to stay updated and adaptable. I'm comfortable wearing multiple hats and learning new things on the job.
HR_questions.negotiation_style: I'm open to reasonable negotiation. Salary should reflect the company's values and my experience and skills—fair alignment on both sides.
HR_questions.company_culture_fit: Red flags for me: racism, gender inequality, illegal activities, and lack of respect. I need an ethical, inclusive workplace where people are treated with dignity.
HR_questions.transparency: If I disagree with a decision, I'll explain my perspective clearly and professionally. Then I respect the authority's decision and move forward. But if the decision is a red flag—something unethical or harmful—I'll raise concerns and, if unresolved, I'll leave.
HR_questions.availability_urgency: Yes, I'm flexible. If there are urgent deadlines or unexpected needs, I can adjust and work extra hours when necessary.
HR_questions.equipment_setup: I need a company laptop/PC. If that's not immediately available, I can temporarily work with my own equipment.
HR_questions.security_protocols: Absolutely. In fintech, security is critical. I'm comfortable following strict protocols—password management, VPN, secure data handling, compliance requirements.
HR_questions.career_progression: In 5–10 years, I see myself as a CTO or technical leader. I want deeper expertise, more responsibility, and the ability to set technical direction and mentor a team. Growth is important to me.
HR_questions.deal_breakers: Same as my red flags: unethical behavior, discrimination, illegal activities, or lack of respect. Also, if the mission becomes unsustainable or the team becomes dysfunctional, I won't stay just for a paycheck. I need to believe in what I'm building.
